themes.name: Rot and Bloom
themes.identity: Decay feeds growth in one endless cycle here — rotted matter is the soil the next bloom needs, and nothing is wasted for long. It sits at the seam between zombie corpse and plant root, the place where 'dead' and 'planted' turn out to be the same word.
avoid: recycling-bin tidiness instead of actual rot
reads the same as charnel-bloom's battlefield-specific necrosis

themes.name: Ember Harvest
themes.identity: This is the last harvest before the frost came, and someone chose to burn the fields rather than lose them to the cold. Warmth here is a hoarded, dwindling resource, not a triumphant blaze — every fire is a fire that has to last.
avoid: industrial furnace or forge imagery (that belongs to thorned-chassis)
fire as an unlimited, roaring resource

themes.name: Frostbitten Vanguard
themes.identity: An army that stopped retreating the moment the cold caught it mid-stride, and kept marching anyway. Every joint is stiff, every command lands half a second late, and nothing in this theme is ever in a hurry.
avoid: sleek, elegant ice-queen or crystalline aesthetics

themes.name: Thorned Chassis
themes.identity: Scrap armor gets bolted onto a living stem here, because a dented helmet works just as well on a vine as it ever did on a skull. The plating is stolen from somewhere else; the growth underneath it is not.
avoid: pure organic growth with no scrap or armor in it

themes.name: Hollow Orchard
themes.identity: An orchard that kept its light after everything around it went dark, tended by something that no longer needs to eat. Sanctity here is a stubborn holdout against the world outside its fence line, not a victory over it.
avoid: loud, showy radiance — this light is quiet
codified doctrine or teaching framing (that is sunwoven-almanac's register, not this orchard's)

themes.name: Umbral Swarm
themes.identity: Numbers, not individuals — a mass that moves and thinks as one smothering tide with no single face to it. Losing any one of them changes nothing, and that facelessness is exactly the point.
avoid: necrotic floral beauty (that is charnel-bloom's register)

themes.name: Windswept Spore
themes.identity: Growth that travels here — spores riding a wind current farther than any root could ever reach on its own. Nothing in this theme holds still, and nothing in it holds ground either.
avoid: heavy armor or bulk of any kind
rootedness, walls, or fortification (that is earthen-bastion's register)
anything that reads as deliberate, planned migration rather than drift

themes.name: Rusted Legion
themes.identity: Whatever the quartermaster had left over gets pressed into service here — a flag, a traffic cone, a folding chair repurposed as a shield. Cohesion comes from rank structure and drill, never from any one piece of kit actually being good.
avoid: anything that looks purpose-designed rather than requisitioned
plant-flesh fusion (that is verdant-graft's or thorned-chassis's register)

themes.name: Verdant Graft
themes.identity: Flesh and stem are sutured together here until neither one is clearly in charge anymore — the graft took, and it is no longer obvious whose body this is. This is the theme where a hybrid frame stops being a compromise and starts being the whole point.
avoid: pure-frame purity — content that reads as cleanly all-plant or all-zombie
resolving the ambiguity of which body is 'really' in control
armor bolted onto an unchanged body (that is thorned-chassis's register)

themes.name: Sunwoven Almanac
themes.identity: The garden's accumulated knowledge, copied and passed hand to hand until it has outlived every gardener who ever added a page to it. This is inheritance, not discovery — nothing here is being found for the first time, only recited correctly.
avoid: a physical sanctuary or place (that is hollow-orchard's register; this theme is a body of knowledge)

themes.name: Charnel Bloom
themes.identity: Flowers that only take root where something died, feeding on whatever the battlefield left behind. Beauty and rot share one stem here, and neither is allowed to apologize for the other.
avoid: generic ecological rot with no battlefield or corpse specificity (that is rot-bloom's broader register)

themes.name: Gilded Porcelain
themes.identity: Painted, jointed, and worth more sitting on a shelf than doing anything useful — until it moves on its own. The value here is decorative first and dangerous second, and it never fully stops being either one.
avoid: sincerity — this theme is inherently artificial and knows it

themes.name: Earthen Bastion
themes.identity: Roots that grew wide instead of tall, turning one garden bed into a wall that nothing gets through easily. This theme is about holding a single line forever, not about ever advancing it.
avoid: mobility, speed, or flight flavor (that is windswept-spore's register)
cyclical rot/growth framing (that is rot-bloom's register)

designNotes.v1Cuts: field-manual cut (a deliberately generic theme becomes the dumping ground for unplaced content); permafrost-seed merged into frostbitten-vanguard (two ice themes, one with an army and one with patience). Both were the authoring agents own nominated weakest. Owner-authorized 2026-08-22.
